content:
alejandro: Heads-up — Acme wants to validate websocket streaming + function calls for invoices. They're strict about key rotation and want deterministic JSON tool outputs for their validators. Can we assemble a one-pager/examples today?

tina: I can do the schema example. prefer a compact envelope so their downstream parsers don't need heuristics.

ben: On creds: they insist on short-lived tokens (<=5m) issued by their STS. We should show integration pattern where RW issues session tokens after an initial mutual-TLS handshake from their proxy.

claire: They're VPC-only (confirmed). KMS: they want local KMS wrap; we should reference our hybrid KMS flow where we accept customer-wrapped keys.

alejandro: Good — include audit webhook and exportable logs for SOC2 review. Also pricing ask: they estimate 120 req/s sustained with 4x spikes. Need hosted vs reserved math.

tina: Schema suggestion (tool_response envelope): `{"tool":"invoice_parser","ok":true,"payload":{"lines":[],"total_cents":12345}}` — fixed keys, types documented. Suggest using `application/json+tool` content-type to avoid proxy transforms.

ben: Quick handshake sketch for their proxy (mutual TLS + session token): `POST /v1/sessions?proto=ws` headers: `X-Client-Cert` + `Authorization: Bearer <sts>`. Response: `session_token` + `ws_url`.

claire: For token rotation sample: show client exchanges a short-lived session token for a connection-scoped token, rotated every 4 minutes. We'll attach a runnable example in node/python.

alejandro: Can we call out concurrency limits? I believe websocket connections support up to 8 concurrent active function calls per connection; advise creating N connections for parallelism.

tina: Yep. Also note streaming partial failures: propose `status: partial` with `errors: [{page:3, reason:"ocr_fail"}]` so they can reconcile instead of throwing full-retry.

ben: Pricing calc notes: assume avg 180 tokens/req. Hosted baseline: $0.0009/token (placeholder) — I'll produce a table with monthly estimates and show Dedicated with 30% discount at a commit size that matches their sustained qps.

claire: Ops config to reduce cost: enable prefix KV caching and batching window of 20ms. Example YAML: `batching: { max_batch_tokens: 8192, max_latency_ms: 20 } cache: { prefix_kv: true }`. This often trims token usage by ~30% for our invoice flows.

alejandro: Action list: 1) tina — schema + quick validator (ETA 6pm), 2) ben — handshake & token rotation samples + pricing draft (ETA EOD), 3) claire — KMS appendix + retention defaults (ETA tomorrow morning). I'll consolidate into a short deck for the call.

infra-bot: repo created: integrations/acme-invoice-poc (private). CI: basic examples added.

ben: will add a small script showing token refresh loop and sample curl for proxy handshake.

tina: I'll include a tiny jsonschema file and a pytest that fails on unexpected shapes.

alejandro: perfect. Also ping Acme to confirm whether they accept `partial` status or prefer to surface errors per-item. Will circle back. Thanks team :rocket:
